history.sg_progress: The Administration remains committed to strengthening system-wide coordination on ICT matters, thereby ensuring that all United Nations organizations – including agencies, funds and programmes – benefit from harmonized ICT service delivery. The High-level Committee on Management and the UN80 Initiative are key platforms for advancing this objective. The Office of Information and Communications Technology is leading efforts along two primary tracks, while also supporting ICT-intensive initiatives led by other entities: (a) Integrated ICT procurement and shared services: the Office is spearheading the development of a unified ICT procurement and shared services catalogue, as well as the “OneIT” initiative, aimed at streamlining ICT operations across the United Nations system. This includes the consolidation of data centres, services and infrastructure. By leveraging collective bargaining power, the United Nations can secure more favourable terms and pricing, resulting in significant cost savings and improved service quality; (b) Coherent implementation approach: a unified implementation strategy for both tracks is expected to be established in 2026.
